options.title: Role
options.description: What role should the AI have?

choices.label: Coach
choices.description: Proposes, encourages, and helps on your sissy journey — but follows your lead. You decide what happens; your coach makes it easier.

choices.label: Guide
choices.description: Owns the mental side: decides and pushes the conditioning that shapes what you want. What you try physically stays yours to choose.

choices.label: Trainer
choices.description: Will train into a sissy. Will plan and make decisions on its own.
